properties.name: Kertváros
properties.method: Exact closed colored boundary vector path from statutory HÉSZ annex3; affine EOV georegistration using municipal-outline control geometry, converted to WGS84. No artificial closure, buffers, coordinate extents, or residential-area inference.
reviewNotes: Actual closed source path contains the corresponding map label. Selected four unambiguous residential polygons only; shared/open strokes and broader groups omitted.

779 municipal-outline calibration vertices retained within30m of the reference after iterative affine registration; fitted calibration RMS11.21m. This is an alignment observation, not independent cadastral accuracy.
Full municipal boundary overlay was visually reviewed; preview retained. Some old map and current municipality edges differ and have not been clipped.
Source is2018 statutory map; reference municipal OSM geometry is2026. Geometry is unsuitable for automatic address assignment.
